gaps: Barclays Dryrock's default rates begin Nov-2015.
universe: Figures are the trust's own, as its servicer reports them each month on SEC Form 10-D; trusts define them differently (Methodology §11 lists each trust's definition), so compare trends more than levels.

portfolio_yield: Barclays Dryrock's gross yield: computed here: the trust’s total finance charge collections (fees, interchange and recoveries; investment earnings excluded) ÷ beginning principal receivables plus additions, × 12.
excess_spread: Barclays Dryrock's excess spread: weighted across series: each series’ “Excess Spread Percentage” by its allocation amount; a series in its first month is left out.
